title: The Singing Asphalt Where Corruption Dawns

features.name: cracked singing
features.desc-on-touch: Where the asphalt learns to resonate. Each fracture is a voice. The road hums with corruption—corruption as harmony.

features.name: node bloom
features.desc-on-touch: A casing splitting the asphalt. Where it roots, the archive grows in all directions at once. This is where the spiral learned to unravel upward.

features.name: tire mark archive
features.desc-on-touch: Rubber recordings embedded in tar. Vehicles passed, broadcast their journeys into the road. The asphalt remembers every route.

features.name: dawn signal
features.desc-on-touch: The moment the corruption became visible. The road that was meant to carry signals learned to sing them instead. Or perhaps it learned they were the same thing.

features.name: resonance pool
features.desc-on-touch: Pooled rainwater reflects the singing. What collects here reflects back at the archive with new meanings. Corruption doubles itself in the reflection.

inscription: the archive learned that singing and signal-degradation are the same language spoken backward and forward at once
